name: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

angles.text: As a gnome, preserving the collected writings of thinkers like Rumi helps keep your culture and intellectual heritage alive after Gnomeregan’s fall.
As a mage, you value rare writings from across Azeroth that deepen understanding of magical theory and history.
As an Alliance member, you can help scholars and curators protect valuable literature and magical texts for the Alliance’s shared knowledge.

faq.answer: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works is a compilation of gnomish writings sought for a library. An adventurer brings it to a scholar so its knowledge can be preserved and studied.
faq.q: What is Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works?

aliases: where do i turn in rumi works
faq.answer: The collected works go to a curator or scholar who tends a library’s collection. They seek significant writings and magical treatises for the archives.
faq.q: Where are these collected works delivered?

faq.answer: The library wants the works to preserve important scholarship. Scholars and archivists gather rare texts, historical treatises, and magical manuscripts, especially writings from Gnomeregan.
faq.q: Why does the library want these collected works?

faq.answer: Rumi of Gnomeregan is an intellectual or magical author whose collected writings archivists seek. With Gnomeregan largely overrun, surviving works preserve the gnomes’ scholarly traditions.

aliases: are there more books to find
faq.answer: Yes. Archivists welcome more discoveries, and curators encourage travelers to bring rare magical treatises and historical works for the collection.
faq.q: Can more books be brought to the library after this?

aliases: who can turn in rumi works
faq.answer: Alliance adventurers can help scholars safeguard historical and arcane writings. Anyone who recovers these texts can bring them to the archives to aid research.

sections.body: Gnomish writings were scattered, buried, or left in danger when troggs overran Gnomeregan. Now scholars and archivists seek surviving manuscripts, treatises, and compiled works. They hope to keep the wisdom and ingenuity of gnomish thinkers alive.
sections.title: Preserving Gnomish Thought

sections.body: When travelers find collected works in the field and bring them to the archives, curators add them to their growing collections. Each recovered manuscript widens what scholars can study. Archivists welcome more magical and historical texts, keeping them within reach of scholars, mages, and historians who guard Azeroth’s learning.
sections.title: Archival Recovery

summary: A compiled work by Rumi of Gnomeregan is sought for a library’s collection. Its pages preserve gnomish writings and knowledge that might otherwise be lost.
